idea: Grocery Price Inflation Spike Drives Staples Rotation

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'grocery prices near me' and 'food price inflation'

behavior: Consumer searches for grocery pricing spike during periods of food inflation anxiety, preceding retail earnings misses and category rotation away from discretionary goods.

market_impact.rationale: Staples outperform when consumer stress on essentials forces budget reallocation away from discretionary purchases.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly Google Trends search interest for grocery price queries exceeds 75th percentile of trailing 52-week distribution
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or when search interest drops below 50th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Food price concerns emerge weekly during inflationary cycles; search volume crosses thresholds multiple times per quarter.

idea: Used Car Price Index Reversal Signals Consumer Credit Relief

data.source: FRED series MMNRNJ (Manheim Used Vehicle Index) weekly data

behavior: Sharp drops in used car prices after sustained highs indicate cooling credit demand and easing transportation cost burden, typically bullish for discretionary spending.

market_impact.rationale: Lower used car prices reduce household debt service, freeing cash for discretionary consumption.

trade_logic.entry: When MMNRNJ drops 3%+ week-over-week after trading above 90th percentile of trailing 6-month range
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or if index reverses 2%+ to upside

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Used car market is volatile; 3% weekly swings occur 2–3 times per quarter, especially in seasonal transitions.

idea: Mortgage Rate Shock Breadcrumb Sell in Financials

data.source: FRED series MORTGAGE30US (30-year mortgage rate) daily data

behavior: Daily jumps in mortgage rates exceeding 25 basis points signal Fed shock or risk-off repricing, compressing mortgage origination demand and bank net interest margin expectations.

market_impact.rationale: Rapid rate increases hurt mortgage banking revenues and weigh on bank equity multiples due to margin compression fears.

trade_logic.entry: When MORTGAGE30US rises 25+ basis points in a single day and closes above 20-day moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or if rate falls 15+ basis points

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Mortgage rate volatility spikes 1–2 times per month during Fed communication cycles and economic data surprises.

idea: Commercial Vehicle Freight Tonnage Collapse Signals Recession Risk

data.source: FRED series TOTALSA (Total Vehicle Miles, seasonally adjusted) weekly data

behavior: Sudden 4%+ week-over-week declines in commercial freight activity index forecasts GDP misses and consumer demand weakness 2–3 weeks ahead.

market_impact.rationale: Freight collapses precede industrial earnings downgrades and signal deteriorating demand across manufacturing and logistics.

trade_logic.entry: When TOTALSA (trucking proxy) drops 4%+ week-over-week and closes below 20-day moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or if tonnage rebounds 2%+ week-over-week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Freight activity is volatile and seasonal; 4% weekly swings occur during demand shocks 3–4 times per year.

idea: Job Posting Collapse Precedes Unemployment Spike

data.source: FRED series JTSJOR (Job Openings, BLS) weekly aggregated from daily scrape

behavior: Sharp drops in weekly job posting counts (7%+ decline) historically lead unemployment rate increases by 2–4 weeks, creating volatility in equity risk sentiment.

market_impact.rationale: Job opening collapses signal impending layoff waves and consumer confidence erosion, suppressing discretionary spending.

trade_logic.entry: When JTSJOR falls 7%+ week-over-week after trading above 60th percentile of 12-month range
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or if job openings stabilize (WoW change > -2%)

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Job openings are cyclical; 7% weekly declines occur 1–2 times per quarter during business cycle downturns.

idea: PPI Input Cost Surge Crushes Materials Futures

data.source: FRED series PPIACO (PPI: All Commodities) weekly data

behavior: Weekly PPI commodity surges exceeding 2% signal sudden input cost inflation, typically followed by 1–2 week margin compression in materials and basic industries.

market_impact.rationale: Raw material cost shocks compress margins in cyclical materials before prices can be passed through to customers.

trade_logic.entry: When PPIACO rises 2%+ week-over-week and closes above 30-day moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or if PPI falls 1%+ week-over-week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: PPI volatility is high; 2% weekly swings occur 4–6 times per year, especially during supply shocks.

idea: Cloud Outage Spike News Drives Cybersecurity Sentiment Surge

data.source: RSS news feed count aggregation for 'cloud outage' and 'AWS outage' from major tech news sources (daily scrape)

behavior: Major cloud infrastructure outages generate 50%+ spike in relevant news mentions, triggering investor focus on cybersecurity and infrastructure resilience investments.

market_impact.rationale: Cloud failures drive enterprise IT budgets toward redundancy, security, and managed service providers.

trade_logic.entry: When daily RSS mention count for 'cloud outage' spikes 50%+ above 20-day moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when mention count falls 30% below spike peak

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Cloud outages occur irregularly but frequently; 1–2 major incidents with 50%+ news spikes occur per quarter.

idea: Extreme Weather Events Drive Insurance Claim Filings Sentiment

data.source: Open-Meteo weather API (daily severe weather alerts, hail, tornado, flood risk) + RSS news count for 'insurance claim surge'

behavior: Severe weather events trigger spikes in insurance claim-related news and search volume, creating short-term volatility in insurance and reinsurance equities.

market_impact.rationale: Extreme weather events create catastrophic loss exposure for insurers, suppressing stock prices ahead of earnings adjustments.

trade_logic.entry: When daily severe weather alerts (tornado, hail, flood) exceed 10 events nationally AND insurance claim news mentions spike 60%+
trade_logic.exit: After 3 trading days or when weather alerts drop below 3 daily events

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Severe weather clusters occur 2–4 times per quarter during seasonal storm seasons, especially spring and fall.

idea: EV Charger Network Density Expansion Signals Infrastructure Thesis

data.source: OpenChargeMap API (monthly EV charger count by state/region)

behavior: Monthly charger network expansion exceeding 5% signals accelerating EV adoption and infrastructure investment, bullish for utilities and green energy stocks.

market_impact.rationale: Charger network growth correlates with utility capex deployment and renewable grid demand, supporting long-term power demand.

trade_logic.entry: When monthly EV charger count growth exceeds 5% month-over-month and exceeds 12-month average growth rate by 2%+
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or if growth drops below 2% month-over-month

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger expansion is steady; 5%+ monthly growth triggers 3–4 times per year during policy/subsidy rollouts.

idea: Healthcare Cost Shock Search Spike Signals XLV Weakness

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'high deductible insurance' and 'medical bill payment plans'

behavior: Spikes in searches for healthcare cost burden and payment plan alternatives signal consumer financial distress tied to medical expenses, pressuring healthcare stocks as demand for care declines.

market_impact.rationale: Rising healthcare cost anxiety precedes declining elective procedure volumes and patient delinquencies in medical billing.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly Google Trends interest for healthcare cost/payment plan searches exceeds 80th percentile of 52-week distribution
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or when search interest drops below 40th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Healthcare cost concerns spike during open enrollment and billing cycle peaks; 80th percentile breaches occur 2–3 times per year.
